rationale: The claim is covered under section 7 (Emergency Medical): the fall and fractured wrist were a sudden injury during the covered trip, treated on the spot, and the itemized bill and medical records required by section 7 are both on file. Nothing in the exclusions applies — the records show no symptoms, visits or medication changes in the 60 days before the policy was bought, so the injury is not pre-existing, and it was not an adventure sport. Per section 10 of the wording the eligible $3,800 is reduced by the Premium $50 deductible, giving $3,750, which is within the $100,000 maximum; because the payout is over $1,000 it needs a claims handler's sign-off before payment (manual section 3).
